items.title: Pakistan: Lady Health Workers’ unions call for formal jobs and social protection at policy dialogue
items.summary: Unions representing Pakistan’s Lady Health Workers (LHWs) called for formal employment, timely wages and social protection at a national policy dialogue with key stakeholders in Islamabad, seeking reforms that would cover nearly 90,000 frontline health workers. items.title: FNV campaign brings Lidl to the table on workload

items.title: UNI GS Christy Hoffman to speak at Paris Summit Against International Oligarchy
